about: Guelph is in southwestern Ontario, east of Kitchener-Waterloo, on the Speed and Eramosa rivers. It is a planned nineteenth-century town with a limestone downtown and a major agricultural university. Manufacturing, agri-food research, and a compact historic core still shape the city. About 140,000 people live in Guelph.
seoSummary: Planned limestone city in southwestern Ontario, home to the University of Guelph.
